title: Ali Institute of Education Lahore Amendment Act 2016

sections.shortTitle: Ali Institute of Education Lahore Amendment Act 2016
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIX OF 2016
ACT XIX OF 2016
ALI
INSTITUTE OF EDUCATION LAHORE (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2016
An Act to amend the Ali Institute of Education Lahore
Act, 2010
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary, 4th March, 2016]
No. PAP/Legis-2(100)/2015/1391,
dated 4-3-2016.---The Ali Institute of Education Lahore
(Amendment) Bill 2015, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on February 26, 2016, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on
March 3, 2016, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab.
It is necessary further to amend the
Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act, 2010 (II of 2010) for increasing the
scope of education being imparted at the Institute and for other purposes.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be cited as the Ali Institute of Education Lahore (Amendment) Act,
2016.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Punjab on February 26, 2016, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on
March 3, 2016, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab.
It is necessary further to amend the
Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act, 2010 (II of 2010) for increasing the
scope of education being imparted at the Institute and for other purposes.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly
of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendment in section 4 of Act II of
2010.---In the Ali Institute of Education Lahore Act, 2010 (II of
2010), in section 4, in subsection (1):
(a) for
clause (i), the following shall be substituted:
(i) provide
instructions and training in the faculty of education aimed at improvement of
teaching skills for teachers in different disciplines as the Board may
determine; subject to the prior approval of the relevant statutory body of
professional education; ; and
(b) for
clause (iv), the following shall be substituted:
(iv) hold examinations in the prescribed manner
and, if a person qualifies the examination, award a degree, certificate and any
other academic distinction to the person; .
